description: A Jupyter Notebook implementing a semi-automated AI chatbot system using LangChain, OpenAI, and GEMINI models for query and answer generation, with database connectivity and prompt engineering.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string combining user question and additional instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a chat completion request to OpenAI's API with the constructed prompt and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes the SQL query against the database and fetches all resulting rows.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL query, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from GEMINI model response parts.
